title: Admin quickfix playlets: micro-playbooks as idempotent, sandboxed support actions
creator: Priya Kapoor
description: Problem: On-call engineers repeatedly perform the same small repair steps (e.g., cache flush, routing table nudge, ephemeral pod restart, KV cache prime) that are time-consuming, error-prone, and hard to audit. Current runbooks are prose-heavy and executed manually across several consoles. Goal: ship a small framework and a first-class UX for 'quickfix playlets'—encoded micro-playbooks that can be executed from the support console or CLI as discrete, versioned tasks. Playlets must be idempotent, sandbox-testable, RBAC-gated, and produce structured audit events for postmortems.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Support console exposes a 'Quick Actions' palette with the first 6 playlets; execution requires proper RBAC mapping and 2-step confirmation for P1-affecting actions.
2) Playlet manifests (YAML/JSON) support input schemas, dry-run mode, and a deterministic idempotency token so replays are safe.
3) Every execution emits structured telemetry: playlet_id, revision, executor, inputs (redacted), outcome, start/end timestamps, and trace_id; events show up in Ops telemetry within 60s.

4) Safety harness provides a local sandbox command `rbx quickfix simulate <playlet>` that runs the playlet against a synthetic environment and returns a deterministic summary; CI must run sandbox simulation for each playlet on PRs.
5) Deploy to 10% of incidents (canary) for two weeks without any P0 regressions before full rollout; rollback plan documented and automated.
6) Unit + integration test coverage for core playlet runtime >= 85%.
7) Documentation (Confluence) with examples, permission matrix, and operator FAQs published and linked in the console help.
8) Reduction target: median time-to-first-fix for common P2 incidents (DB connection resets, cache thrash, short-lived node restarts) decreases by >=25% within six weeks after rollout.
updates: 2026-03-10 - Ticket created: scoped MVP runtime + 6 starter playlets (cache-flush, ingress-reload, worker-restart, kv-prime, config-bump, tracing-toggle).

2026-03-11 - Architecture sync with infra/console: agreed on plugin-based runtime with strict capability tokens and sandbox API. Action: prototyping runtime shim (ENG-1009999-PR) and sample playlet manifests.
2026-03-12 - Security review kickoff: asked security to review capability model; initial feedback requests least-privilege mapping to existing SAML groups and audit enrichment for KMS usage.
2026-03-13 - UX review: design provided confirmation modal flow and 'dry run' indicator; asked console team to reserve top-level Quick Actions slot and keyboard shortcut.
2026-03-14 - Implemented basic runtime CLI `rbx quickfix run --playlet` and sandbox simulate; integration tests failing for idempotency token collision case (investigating).
test_plan: Local unit tests for runtime (mock exec, permission checks, idempotency store).
Sandbox simulation harness: runs playlet against a fixture cluster in CI (nightly + PR smoke).
End-to-end integration test: console UI -> API -> runtime -> mock infra with golden logs asserted.
Chaos validation: run playlets during synthetic load and ensure SLO violations are not introduced (safety gating).
Security fuzzing: malformed playlet manifests and elevated-input attempts must be rejected; test harness to exercise KMS/HSM flows.
Telemetry assertion: synthetic executions must produce events with required fields; alert on missing fields.
Performance: cold-start runtime latency < 250ms for common playlets; concurrency test for 50 simultaneous quickfix executions.
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Feature-flagged deploy to dev/qa clusters; invite SREs for early trials.
Phase 1: Canary at 10% of incidents and 20% of oncall users (two-week window); monitor telemetry and error budget impact.
Phase 2: Expand to all support console sessions; enforce RBAC and 2FA confirmation for P1 actions.
Phase 3: Full GA and include playlet authoring UI + governance (approval workflow for new/revamped playlets).
Rollback criteria: any P0 regressions, >2% increase in incident recurrence for remediated incidents, or missing telemetry for >5% of executions triggers immediate rollback.
Communication: Announce on #ops, ship a short recording walkthrough, and schedule two office hours for authors and SREs.
telemetry: Event schema: playlet.exec (fields: playlet_id, revision, actor, actor_group, inputs_hash, outcome, start_ts, end_ts, trace_id, dry_run=false/true)
Sampling: record full payload for failed runs; sample 1/10 for successful runs to reduce cost but keep aggregate metrics accurate.
Dashboards: playlet usage (count), success_rate, median_duration, top failing playlets, recent audit log samples.
Alerts: alert if playlet success_rate drops by >15% week-over-week or if avg execution latency > 2s for >5 minutes.
Retention: structured telemetry retained 90 days, raw console audit linked logs retained per compliance policy.
